title: Arizer Glass Potpourri Dish for Extreme Q
description:
Enhance your aromatherapy experience with the Arizer Glass Potpourri Dish for Extreme Q. Designed for use with the Extreme Q and V-Tower, this high-quality glass potpourri dish evenly heats botanicals, releasing soothing scents for relaxation. Crafted from durable glass, this potpourri dish is perfect for freshening any space. Simply add your favorite potpourri (not included) to the dish and enjoy long-lasting aromas. Compatible with Arizer Solo 2, this versatile glass aromatherapy dish is an essential accessory for those who appreciate natural scents.

Elevate your environment with this premium bowl designed for seamless performance. Order now for an enhanced experience!
